{{Quote|&hellip;All units, look out for Jedi, young Jedi, possibly disguised now&hellip;Do not approach, I say again do not approach, armed and dangerous, call for military backup immediately&hellip;May not have braids, repeat, may have removed identifying marks&hellip;Copy that, Five-Seven&hellip;No, numbers unknown&hellip;Yes, confirm that, arson is suspected, fire investigation team is seeking access, requires military escort, please advise&hellip;Confidential material has been destroyed&hellip;Jedi may be trying to escape with highly sensitive security data, so this is top priority&hellip;Chancellor's office&hellip;Military has orders to shoot on sight&hellip;Person of special interest, male, Teevan, Veld first name Tru, do not approach, call for Five-oh-first backup immediately&hellip;|A CSF comm channel during Order 66|<ref name="Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref>}}
The '''Coruscant Security Force Dispatch''', also known as '''Coruscant Central''', was the dispatch and central communications system for the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]]. The controller's answered emergency calls and dispatched [[Police officer/Legends|police officers]] through the CSF comm channels. The controllers also had access to the [[Coruscant Security Force database|CSF database]].
